source: his 2026-10-21 06:57: "write the local 5, use your pen names". The five old artifact_local fight families (Bounty, Danger, Dismantle, Strike, Hunt: 42 quests), one new Delve each, each person written by a different pen name.
_note: PEN NAME: home-office office/pennames/nan-drury.json. Her heat checks do not apply (Overtime is adult, not explicit, his 10-12); her voice does.
BOUNTY, THE WATER RAIDER. Second local Delve of the old Bounty family (22a was the first: an Ecliptic collector).
Crimson Fleet this time, holed up and coming down for the homesteads' water: the old qst04 slate, 'we lie low
here till it blows over', seen from the people below. defeat on remote05a's boss and the Crimson gang, smaller.
Nan's tell: a number that is never the point of its sentence (four times since the rains, off since Thursday).
Her bans: the witty refusal, menace, an antagonist anyone enjoys. The homesteader is not angry; she is counting.

RE-CUT 2026-10-21 16:36 for the ear, his "when you split the lines that small Elevenlabs has no context so the delivery is worse" and "yeah recut, they aren't made yet": each speech is one or two whole responses, split only where a real pause belongs.

place._theme: A built hostile site, where a raider and a few of his crew would hole up.

prose.name: Bounty: Crimson Fleet Raider on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A Crimson Fleet raider has holed up at the <Place> with a few of his crew. He comes down to take water from the homesteads round about. They have pooled what they can for whoever stops him.

beats.objective: Defeat the Crimson Fleet raider at the <Place>
beats.journal: The raider at the <Place> is dead. The homesteads round about can stop counting their water.
say: He's done, then? I'll turn the tank back on. We've had it off since Thursday.

broadcast: There's a man up the way who comes down for our water. He's been four times since the rains stopped.
We've put a bit together between us for whoever stops him.
_speech: Radio rules: no names, places, factions or currency ('a bit put together', never how much). Voice is 'Lucy' (British, casual), used twice so far, on survey crews; his ear decides.
